findings.detail: testbench checks TIMING_0 (offset 0x08) resets to 0x271C0B0B, but the spec's csr_register_map declares reset_value 0x21180909. Likely a stale hardcoded expected value in the testbench, not an RTL bug -- confirm what the RTL actually resets to before assuming otherwise.

testbench writes 0x1ABC0000 to BIST_ADDR_START (offset 0x24) and expects an EXACT readback match, but bits 0x10000000 of that value fall in this register's reserved range (mask 0xF0000000, derived from its spec-declared fields). Correct RTL that pins reserved bits can never pass this exact-match check -- the test is unsound regardless of what the RTL does.

testbench writes 0x1FFFFFFF to BIST_ADDR_END (offset 0x28) and expects an EXACT readback match, but bits 0x10000000 of that value fall in this register's reserved range (mask 0xF0000000, derived from its spec-declared fields). Correct RTL that pins reserved bits can never pass this exact-match check -- the test is unsound regardless of what the RTL does.
